title: CardFrameDesignParams
description: Design parameters for generating a card frame. Region positions come from layout.json and cannot be overridden.

id.description: Slug for this frame variant, e.g. fire-lava-v1

theme.description: High-level theme name, e.g. fire, ice, forest, void, storm

mood.description: Atmosphere / feeling, e.g. fierce, serene, corrupted, regal

palette.description: Core colors for the frame. Hex preferred (#RRGGBB).

border.description: e.g. charred rock, polished obsidian, living wood, frost crystal

panels.description: e.g. dark slate with glowing edges

ornament.description: e.g. molten metal, ethereal runes, thorns

side_fill.description: What fills the left/right vertical borders, e.g. flowing flames, ice veins, vines

crest.description: Emblem used at top center and bottom center peak

motif.description: e.g. stylized flame, crescent moon, oak leaf

title_box_style.description: Visual treatment of the locked title box, e.g. dark panel with glowing inner stroke

footer_box_style.description: Visual treatment of the locked bottom boxes

ornaments.description: Extra decorative motifs allowed outside locked regions

prompt_extras.description: Freeform notes for AI image generation beyond structured fields
